description: Recommends a practical next-step category based on business goal, workflow complexity, implementation readiness, risk level, preferences, and missing information.

aiIdea.description: AI or automation idea the user is considering.

businessType.description: Type of business, such as ecommerce, SaaS, consulting, agency, local service, or solo business.

constraints.description: Known constraints such as budget, team capacity, tools, timeline, compliance needs, or data access.

currentGoal.description: Current business goal the user wants the review to support.

currentProblem.description: Main business or workflow problem the user wants to solve.

currentWorkflow.description: How the relevant workflow currently works, including manual steps, tools, handoffs, and review points.

goal90Days.description: Desired business or workflow outcome over the next 90 days.

hasExistingAutomation.description: Whether the business already has automation or AI workflows in place.

implementationReadiness.description: How ready the business appears for implementation.

notes.description: Any additional context the user wants considered in the review.

offer.description: Core product, service, package, or outcome the business sells.

problemComplexity.description: Estimated complexity of the business or workflow problem.

readiness.description: Simplified readiness level if already known.

revenueModel.description: How the business earns revenue, such as projects, retainers, subscriptions, services, or products.

riskConcerns.description: Concerns related to customer trust, brand reputation, legal exposure, sensitive data, or quality control.

riskLevel.description: Estimated risk level or uncertainty for the workflow.

targetCustomer.description: Primary customer segment or buyer the business serves.

teamSize.description: Approximate team size and key roles involved in the workflow.

timeline.description: Desired timeline for review, documentation, pilot, or implementation.

userGoal.description: Goal the user wants the next step to support.

wantsDoneForYou.description: Whether the user prefers implementation support rather than self-guided work.

wantsSelfGuided.description: Whether the user prefers self-guided resources or templates.

name: recommend_next_step

alternativePaths.description: Other reasonable next-step categories the user could consider.

confidence.description: Confidence level based on the clarity and completeness of the provided business context.

missingInformation.description: Information the user should provide to improve routing confidence.

readinessLevel.description: Estimated readiness level for the recommended path.

reason.description: Reason this next-step category fits the supplied context.

suggestedAction.description: Practical action the user can take next.

title: Recommend Next Step
